On a Shape's color popup, pressing Custom opens its view and changes no value: fill and Save stay as they were until the map or a bar is moved. That is what lets the same press be tried on a Forms > Colors row.
A Forms > Colors row's popover opens with 5 dots, a Custom tile and an opacity bar, and opening and closing it changes no row, variable or Save.
If Custom holds on Forms > Colors: a map, a hue bar and hex row as in CAP-T6CUSTOM, at the row's color, and the opacity bar reads 100.
how: Blocks Probe. No pick in Site Styles. The Shape read is on a new unsaved block, not in Site Styles. Custom on a Forms > Colors row is pressed only if the Shape read shows no write, with Save and the row read before and after; if anything changes it stops there and is told.
